name: Vert.x Best Practices Compliance
description: Evaluate Vert.x verticle code against best practices and common anti-patterns

deployment.description: Proper verticle deployment and lifecycle management

rules.name: Uses DeploymentOptions
rules.description: Verticle deployment should use DeploymentOptions for configuration
rules.suggestion: Use DeploymentOptions to configure verticle deployment

rules.name: Uses Promise for Async Start
rules.description: Verticle start method should use Promise for proper async initialization

error_handling.description: Proper error handling in async operations

rules.name: Async Error Handling
rules.description: Async operations should have error handlers
rules.suggestion: Always check ar.succeeded() and handle ar.failed() cases

rules.name: Try-Catch for Blocking Code
rules.description: Blocking operations should be wrapped in try-catch
rules.suggestion: Wrap blocking code in try-catch blocks

rules.name: No Blocking in Event Loop
rules.description: Thread.sleep and blocking operations should not be in event loop
rules.suggestion: Use vertx.setTimer() or executeBlocking() instead of Thread.sleep()

rules.name: Avoid printStackTrace
rules.description: Use proper logging instead of printStackTrace

rules.name: Uses config() Method
rules.description: Verticle should use config() method for configuration
rules.suggestion: Use config().get*() methods to access configuration

rules.name: No Hardcoded Credentials
rules.description: Credentials should not be hardcoded in source code
rules.suggestion: Move credentials to configuration files or environment variables

rules.name: No Hardcoded URLs
rules.description: URLs and endpoints should be externalized

database.description: Database client usage and connection pooling

rules.name: Uses Connection Pooling
rules.description: Database connections should use connection pools
rules.suggestion: Use connection pools (PgPool, MySQLPool) instead of individual connections

rules.name: Parameterized Queries
rules.description: Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
rules.suggestion: Use preparedQuery with parameters instead of string concatenation

rules.name: No SQL String Concatenation
rules.description: SQL queries should not use string concatenation
rules.suggestion: Use parameterized queries instead of string concatenation

http.description: HTTP server and client best practices

rules.name: Uses Vert.x Router
rules.description: HTTP servers should use Vert.x Web Router

rules.name: Global Error Handler
rules.description: Router should have global error handler
